A troupe from Manipur performs at the Mysuru palace on the final day of Dasara celebrations. | Photo Credit: M.A. SRIRAM
Featuring the attractive tableaux portraying the regional specialities, cultural heritage and social messages, the grand Jamboo Savari held on the premises of Mysuru Palace on Wednesday kept spectators spellbound throughout the procession.
The Indian Army’s tableau was also part of Vijayadashami celebrations in Mysuru on Wednesday (October 21). | Photo Credit: M.A. Sriram
The procession featured 53 tableaux and 46 traditional folk art forms and lasted around two to three hours. It began with a Nadaswaram performance, followed by the tableaux presented by several zilla panchayats of the State, boards, authorities, Mysuru zoo, Indian Army, Indian Navy, Air Force and Central Government Institutions. Tableaux representing the art and culture of Tamil Nadu and Kerala were also part of the procession.
The Mandya Zilla Panchayat tableau, titled ‘Asmithe-Unveiling of Women’s Power’ conveyed the message of discrimination free society and equal opportunity to women. Depiction of a mother feeding her baby, menstrual cups, Akka Café and Shishu Sanjeevini highlighted women’s empowerment and welfare initiatives. Belagavi Zilla Panchayat showcased Belavadi Mallamma, the heroic queen from the region, while a tableau depicting the first Dasara celebrations during the Vijayanagara Empire offered a glimpse into the festival’s historical origins.
Vidhurashwatha, known as the Jallianwala Bagh of South India, featured in the Chickballapur district tableau. The Mysuru tableau highlighted the city’s journey towards the future, built on a strong foundation, with a hilltop temple forming part of its presentation.
Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) showcased India’s indigenous aerospace and defense capabilities. The Indian Institute of Science (IISc) celebrated 117 years of scientific excellence and nation-building through its tableau. New Mangalore Port Trust (NMPT), Karnataka’s maritime gateway, displayed a replica of a cruise ship.
The Karnataka Tourism Department highlighted the natural beauty and rich cultural heritage of the Malnad and coastal regions. Indian Railways showcased the evolution of locomotives and its eco-friendly initiatives. The Indian Navy’s tableau, themed around Atmanirbhar Bharat, highlighted indigenous warship designs and technological innovations, while the Indian Army’s presentation blended soldiers’ courage with technological transformation and preparedness for future battles.
Other notable tableaux included the Department of Youth Empowerment and Sports showcasing the concept of Bharat Jodo, Tibetan Settlement at Bylakuppe, The Mysuru Hotel Owners’ Association, showcasing Mysuru Pak and Masala Dosa; the Karnataka Milk Federation, Karnataka Soaps and Detergents, The Social Welfare Department and Karnataka Tanda Development Corporation. The Chamarajanagar tableau highlighted sacred sites and folk heritage amid forest wealth, while the Tulunadu tableau celebrated the region’s rich culture and traditions.
The Institute of Nephrology in its tableau highlighted the importance of kidney and its donation.
The Sri Chamarajendra Zoological Gardens tableau, titled A Journey into the World of Wonders, reflected the 135-year-old heritage of Mysuru zoo and its continuing efforts towards wildlife conservation.
The Tamil Nadu tableau bearing the tagline where stories never end, featured its two iconic attractions the Shore temple of Mamallapuram and Jallikattu.
A tableau from Keralam was also featured in the Vijayadashami procession in Mysuru on Wednesday (October 21). | Photo Credit: M.A. Sriram
Keralam’s boat shaped tableau brought together its living arts, diverse communities and tropical beauty. The towering Theyyam figure and colourful depiction of Kathakkali were eye-catching.
Veeragase Kunitha, Kangeelu, Keelu Kudure, Kudubi dance, Gorava kunitha, Manipura folk dance, Garudi Gombe, Dollu kunitha by Women Troupe, Halakki Suggi dance, Thanda dance and other folk dances were performed by the artists alongside the tableaux.
